text: ___ (MDF) optimization finds metabolite concentrations that maximize the minimum Gibbs free energy drop (ΔrG) across every reaction in a pathway, thereby identifying the thermodynamic bottleneck reaction.
explanation: Max-Min Driving Force optimization searches over feasible metabolite concentrations to maximize the smallest (least favorable) ΔrG among all reactions in a pathway, ensuring every step is simultaneously thermodynamically feasible and pinpointing whichever reaction is the bottleneck. This differs from simple ΔrG° calculation tools like eQuilibrator, which compute standard free energies but do not optimize concentrations across a whole pathway.
